title: Pre-Analysis — Substitution of Hard Chrome Plating by an HVOF Coating on the Main Gear Sliding Tube

ata.title: Main Gear — Main Gear Leg Assembly

abstract: Original pre-analysis of replacing the hard chrome plated sliding tube by a thermally sprayed carbide coated item, driven by the withdrawal of the plating process at the overhaul network.

sections.objective: Decide whether a thermally sprayed carbide coating can replace hard chrome plating on the main gear sliding tube without changing the overhaul interval, the seal specification or the removal and installation procedure. The change is forced rather than chosen: the plating line at two of the three overhaul providers is closing. Pre-analysis was asked to confirm that the substitution is invisible to the operator and to identify anything in the published content that assumes the plated item.
sections.findings_summary: Three items were confirmed and the substitution came through cleanly. The gear leg removal task calls the sliding tube by a part number that changes with the coating, and because the task is used at every gear change it is the single place where an operator would notice the substitution; it needs both items listed rather than a replacement. The part list figure carries the plated tube with no alternate, so a station ordering from the figure would order an item that is no longer made. The third item is only a similarity: a fuselage joint protection change raised in the same period is driven by the same regulatory withdrawal of a legacy surface treatment, and its coupon and adhesion evidence is directly reusable, but the two share no identifier and neither dossier referred to the other.
sections.next_steps: List both sliding tube items in the gear leg removal task with a note on interchangeability, and add an alternate item to the part list figure rather than replacing the existing one. Ask materials and processes to make the coupon and adhesion evidence gathered for the fuselage joint protection change available to this dossier so it is not repeated. No condition is placed on the substitution itself; the overhaul interval is unchanged.

expected_findings.rationale: The gear leg removal task names the sliding tube by an item number that changes with the coating. It is used at every gear change, so it is where an operator meets the substitution first and where a wrong order is most likely.
expected_findings.resolution: List both items in the task with an interchangeability note rather than replacing one with the other.

expected_findings.rationale: The figure carries the plated tube with no alternate item. A station ordering from it after the plating line closes would order something that is no longer manufactured.
expected_findings.resolution: Add the coated item as an alternate rather than superseding the plated one.

evidence.similarity_note: Both dossiers answer the same regulatory withdrawal of a legacy surface treatment, and both had to build adhesion and coupon evidence for a substitute. Nothing in the wording overlaps — 'tungsten carbide coating in place of hard chrome plating' against 'interfay sealing and corrosion protection improvement' — and there is no shared part number, functional item number, drawing or zone.

expected_findings.rationale: The evidence package one dossier is building is directly reusable by the other, and neither knew of the other because they sit in different chapters with different design offices.
expected_findings.resolution: Ask materials and processes to share the coupon and adhesion evidence between the two dossiers.

expected_non_findings.reason: Sits in the same two-digit chapter and shares the landing gear bay zone that the entity pass keyed on, but it isolates a brake control fault after a software change. It shares no part number with the gear leg and cannot be affected by a coating substitution on the sliding tube.

type_data.conclusion: Closed with a positive position and no conditions. The substitution is invisible to the operator once both items appear in the removal task and in the part list figure.
